limits: The complete 94-source selection records 140 passed, eight failed and 32 metadata-unsupported modes. All source/mode/harness/policy and preflight fingerprints are preserved.

116 modes gain passes; all 64 other complete new-profile observations and every prior profile observation remain identical. The 24 before passes were incidental TypeError assertions, not implementation validation.

All eight remaining failures are both modes of four array-altered-during-loop.js sources. Source/control-flow inspection shows callbacks reaching missing Array.prototype.splice; the unchanged generic TypeError text alone does not locate that dependency.

All 504 independently frozen local modes pass unchanged, with all 12 assertion controls verified. New upstream controls verify 288/288 after and 160/288 before; all 128 new positive method controls failed before implementation.

All four methods capture ToLength, read every original-range index through live Get including holes, and short circuit on ToBoolean. Selected values are retained before callback mutation; descending indices use bounded scalar arithmetic, never a materialized logical index range.

Per-index key construction, prototype walking, callback storage and calls share existing work/heap/recursion limits. Lookup work now accounts for property/parameter/hole tree sizes, intrinsic-name lookups and actual borrowed mapped binding-name length before reading its value.

The first release candidate reached work limits in two formerly passing lastIndexOf variants. All initial artifacts and exact regressions are retained. Decimal key construction now precharges its actual 1–16 digit count and fills exactly that many stack slots; its 64-byte allocation charge and all stronger lookup charges remain unchanged.

No work, heap, recursion quota or process authority was increased. Thirteen private groups check partial effects, exact allocation refusal, sparse full-range early returns, mapped aliases, lazy host/depth limits and terminal cleanup.

The initial focused private run had 12 passes and one invalid native-callback test setup. The setup was corrected to retrieve installed Boolean; the targeted rerun and all final full suites pass. Frozen semantic fixtures and production code were not changed to fit that setup.

Proxy, typed/resizable arrays, cross-realm behavior and full with/Array unscopables support remain unfinished. Bounded source/tooling review and local tests are not a whole-engine security audit. No GPU exercise or Chromium performance comparison was performed.

record.kind: Bounded independent planning review for the four Array find methods
record.status: Proposals only; no find implementation reviewed or executed
record.spec_summary: Snapshot ToLength after ToObject; validate callability even for empty input. Visit every index with Get, call with value/index/original object, and return saved value or index on truthiness. Missing/deleted indices are visited. Ascending/descending traversal can stream the specified logical list without materializing it.
existing_helper_review: array_method already orders ToObject/admitted-host check/length Get and numeric conversion before its callback arms. Length is u64 clamped to 2^53-1; no unconditional 65536 cap exists in this path.

reduce_get performs one charged property walk and calls an accessor with the original receiver; it returns an owned Value before later callbacks, so the proposed find arm need not retain arena/vector borrows.
reduce_property charges current short-key work and 128 bytes before own_property on each reached supported edge; MAX_DEPTH bounds cycles. Actual host fallback is rejected only when reached.

reduce_index_key charges 17 work and 64 bytes before constructing at most 16 UTF-16 decimal digits. Find maximum visited index is 2^53-2, so descending offset arithmetic stays inside the helper contract.

Runtime::call charges tick and native stack/call guards, delegates to machine::invoke_preentered, then restores logical count/stack. The drive cleanup truncates frames and restores entry state on success, semantic errors and resource/unsupported exits.
Value::truthy is allocation-free and does not consult getters/coercion hooks. Long strings are tested by emptiness only.

Current forEach/map/filter/every/some arm uses HasProperty plus Get and skips holes. It must not be reused unchanged for find. A separate Get-only arm avoids duplicate property work and implements required hole callbacks.

concrete_helper_findings.status: Reported to parent; no code changed
concrete_helper_findings.finding: Mapped argument indexed Get can compare an arbitrarily long retained binding name without matching work precharge. reduce_property charges 1+key.len()/8 for key "0", but own_property then reads environments[env].bindings[name]. A 4097-byte simple parameter name forces a full equality comparison even in a single-binding map.
concrete_helper_findings.proposal: Before calling own_property on an admitted edge, conservatively precharge actual mapped binding-name bytes times the environment lookup comparison bound, borrowing metadata rather than cloning the name. Reuse or factor the approach already used by integrity_define. Keep valid alias semantics and all quotas unchanged.
regressions: Existing reduce/every/some and other walker consumers targeted tests
concrete_helper_findings.qualification: Static concrete accounting gap, not an executed timing or exploit result.

concrete_helper_findings.status: Scoped comparison-accounting recommendation requested by parent
concrete_helper_findings.finding: The walker precharges 1+key.len()/8 per edge regardless of the values/parameter_map/array_holes search-tree sizes. The query key is short and bounds each UTF-16 comparison, but it does not bound the number of BTreeMap/BTreeSet comparisons as the stored shape grows. own_property may search values then parameter_map, or search array_holes for a dense slot. Existing heap/node caps bound total tree size; this is an accounting mismatch, not an unbounded-key allocation.
concrete_helper_findings.proposal: Before the edge read, conservatively account for the short query length and logarithmic comparison allowance of the actually relevant values and parameter_map trees, plus array_holes when the receiver is an array. Use checked/saturating arithmetic and charge before the searches they cover; retain the separate actual mapped binding-name/environment comparison charge from H1. Avoid copying keys/names or scanning entries. Reuse the resolved ordinary property-object ID where practical. Native property-object resolution/prototype lookup uses a separate small intrinsic-name map; include its bounded lookup allowance or explicitly document the existing shared helper boundary.
concrete_helper_findings.qualification: No proposed numerical coefficient is asserted to count exact Rust std B-tree primitive operations. Use a documented conservative comparison allowance compatible with current accounting conventions; no cap increases/refunds or outcome filtering.

implementation_boundaries: Use a separate four-name match arm; capture predicate/thisArg as owned Values, validate callback after length conversion, retain the returned Get value before calling author code, and select saved value/index without re-reading.
Iterate offset in 0..length; descending index length-1-offset only inside that loop. No usize conversion of logical length and no Vec of all indices.
Charge and fallibly reserve exactly three Value argument slots after successful Get and before extending/calling. Preserve all completed getter effects if this preflight fails.

Add intrinsic registration and early Array native dispatch consistently; do not fall through generic native handling that scans ignored argument contents. Method metadata/alias coverage belongs in independent local cases.
Keep host/exotic exclusions explicit. This plan does not authorize Proxy, typed-array, Date, BigInt or broader Window property semantics.

controls.name: find_callback_vector_preflight_preserves_completed_getter_effects
controls.purpose: Place a heap refusal after the indexed getter and before predicate invocation.
setup: Prepare identical fresh Runtime/Document instances with an ordinary object of length 1, a configurable index-0 getter that changes a retained marker and returns a distinct value, and a predicate that increments a separate counter. Parse/setup before measuring budgets.

Measure the real entry, length Get/conversion, one visit tick, index-key creation and ONE indexed reduce_get on a separate instance. Do not include the HasProperty/reduce_property prefix used by every/some/reduce: find does not have that operation.
Compute the actual fixed three-Value vector charge from size_of::<Value>() and the final implementation; admit the measured prefix and one byte less than that charge on a fresh setup.
controls.action: Call each of find/findIndex/findLast/findLastIndex directly through array_method, with a prebuilt argument Vec outside the measured budget.
assertions: ResourceLimit occurs before vector reserve/predicate entry; getter marker is retained, predicate counter stays zero, returned object/property state matches getter effects, and no result is fabricated.
When the exact failing charge crosses by one byte, allocated is MAX_HEAP+1; otherwise assert the reached boundary without guessing allocation constants.
Calls, stack_units, eval_depth, json_depth, frames and active_array_joins return to their entry boundaries; read retained state directly without execute resetting the work budget.

controls.name: find_holes_pay_for_get_and_predicate_not_hasproperty_skip
controls.purpose: Catch reusing the sparse-skipping every/some arm.
setup: Prepare a null-prototype ordinary receiver of length 3 with no indexed own properties and a false-returning predicate with a retained visit counter; also a getterless accessor at one index and an explicit undefined data control.
For a first-hole allocation failure, measure the same one-Get prefix as F01, ending with Undefined, and leave one byte less than the three-argument vector allowance.
controls.action: Invoke all four methods once successfully and once at the callback-vector boundary.
assertions: All three indices invoke the predicate with Undefined in the correct direction; an accessor with no getter also invokes it. Missing result is Undefined for value methods and -1 for index methods.
The low-heap variant is ResourceLimit, not a successful missing result. No callback occurs before failed vector allocation.
A truthy predicate on the first hole returns immediately with Undefined or the actual first index, so absence cannot be confused with not-yet-visited.

controls.name: find_early_return_is_independent_of_logical_length
controls.purpose: Prove no index list, logical-length reservation or u32 truncation.
setup: Use ordinary receivers with ToLength values 1, 65537, 4294967295, 4294967296, 9007199254740991, Infinity and 1e100. Place exactly one own value at index 0 for ascending methods or effectiveLength-1 for descending methods.
Use a fixed predicate returning true at its first invocation, created before taking cost baselines. Repeat with a first hole and with a real sparse array of u32::MAX length.
controls.action: Call the direct method with a fixed modest allowance independent of logical length.
assertions: Exactly one predicate call; descending maximum index is 9007199254740990, and no integer overflow or lossy usize conversion occurs.

No index-vector/result-array allocation or retained storage proportional to length. Compare charged heap across identical shapes; allow work differences caused by actual decimal-key length, not range size.
A zero-length receiver never computes length-1 and still validates callback callability. Infinity and huge positive values clamp to the safe-integer limit.

controls.name: find_index_key_precharges_before_digit_storage
controls.purpose: Reuse the actual bounded helper contract at numeric boundaries.
setup: Create a Runtime before measurement; use indices 0, 9, 10, 4294967294 and 9007199254740990.
Separately set steps=16, then steps=17 with allocated=MAX_HEAP-64, then steps=17 with allocated=MAX_HEAP-63.
controls.action: Call reduce_index_key directly, retaining its current 17-work/64-byte contract unless the helper is intentionally changed and reviewed.
assertions: Work refusal allocates nothing; exact success yields the exact decimal UTF-16 string; one-byte heap shortage is ResourceLimit before construction.
A value above the documented safe-integer helper range is rejected before its 16-unit buffer can underflow. Find itself must never generate that value.

controls.name: find_live_getters_keep_receiver_and_pre_callback_value
controls.purpose: Cover mutation ordering without borrowed array/property storage across callbacks.
setup: Use ordinary and sparse-array receivers with inherited index getters asserting original receiver identity. The first getter or predicate mutates the next value, deletes a later own value to reveal an inherited value, shrinks length and adds an out-of-range entry.
Use a single-element getter that deletes/replaces itself and returns a token; the predicate replaces the indexed value, mutates its argument bindings and returns truthy.
controls.action: Execute each directional method once under normal limits; inspect a bounded visit log and final descriptors.
assertions: Traversal keeps the original range and direction but does a fresh Get per visit; deleted indices still invoke predicates with inherited values or Undefined.
Returned value is the token read before the predicate, not a re-read replacement or mutated callback argument binding. Mutating the token object itself remains visible through its identity.
No constructor/species/iterator protocol is consulted, and no receiver property is written by the method.

controls.name: find_mapped_argument_names_are_precharged
controls.purpose: Expose the concrete existing walker comparison gap.
setup: Prepare retained sloppy arguments from real simple-parameter functions with binding names of 1, 257 and 4097 UTF-8 bytes; keep the visible index key "0" in every case. Change the retained parameter binding so the stored descriptor value is stale.
After the helper is fixed, measure the prefix before the actual mapped-name comparison and give just insufficient work on a fresh identical setup. Do not clone long names merely to charge them.
controls.action: Invoke reduce_get directly to isolate the edge, then all four find methods through the normal shared helper with a first-match callback.
assertions: Success reads the live mapped parameter value. Actual comparison work grows with name length and environment search depth, while borrowed name handling adds no name-sized temporary allocation.
Insufficient work refuses before own_property performs the long environment lookup or before predicate entry; prior length/getter effects remain and aliases/descriptors are unchanged.
Unmapped arguments and ordinary short keys retain their existing behavior. Shared helper consumers need focused regression checks because the fix affects methods beyond find.
controls.caveat: This is a prerequisite/helper finding, not a tested exploit. No engine execution was performed during planning.

controls.name: find_host_and_prototype_boundaries_are_reached_lazily
controls.purpose: Preserve explicit unsupported hosts without widening them via sidecars.
setup: Prepare valid Window/Document/Node/Style targets with any existing symbol sidecars; separately ordinary objects with own length/index data and a Window prototype.
Prepare a valid-ID two-object prototype cycle with an own length but missing visited index, plus a long acyclic chain ending in an indexed getter.
controls.action: Call all four methods on direct hosts, first-match ordinary objects, and reached missing/host/cyclic paths.
assertions: Direct hosts remain UnsupportedFeature before reading their DOM/global fields. An ordinary object with all needed own properties succeeds even when its prototype is a host.
A reached host prototype is UnsupportedFeature and prevents predicate entry; a valid-ID cycle consumes bounded per-edge work/128-byte scratch then returns ResourceLimit.
The original receiver reaches an inherited getter, not the prototype owner. A first successful match prevents later hostile edges from being reached.
controls.caveat: Do not use invalid/out-of-range arena IDs; this plan reviews valid retained graphs only.

controls.name: find_boxed_string_edge_scratch_precedes_unit_allocation
controls.purpose: Check the real one-code-unit temporary allocation in own_property.
setup: Prepare a boxed string with units [0x41,0xD800,0xDFFF] and an already-created length/index key. Keep the wrapper and property bag untouched.
At reduce_get direct entry set enough work and allocated=MAX_HEAP-127, then a separate exactly sufficient 128-byte edge allowance.
controls.action: Read a virtual string index through the shared walker; run normal find-family callbacks over the wrapper in both directions.
assertions: Insufficient edge allowance fails before the one-unit JsString allocation; exact allowance returns the original UTF-16 unit without scalar replacement.
No synthetic own descriptor is created. Callback object identity is the one ToObject wrapper, reused across all indices; explicit object wrappers remain unchanged.

controls.name: find_truthiness_and_saved_values_do_not_invoke_conversion
controls.purpose: Ensure only ToBoolean and owned saved values follow callback completion.
setup: Prepare a truthy object result with throwing getters for Symbol.toPrimitive, valueOf, toString and then; prepare value tokens including NaN, -0, Symbol, long Rc strings and object references.
controls.action: Invoke all four methods with predicates returning the poison truthy object, and false/zero/NaN/empty-string/null/undefined controls.
assertions: No conversion or promise hook is accessed; value methods preserve SameValue identity and signed zero, while index methods return the numeric index.
False controls continue; shared strings/objects are cloned by reference without deep copying. Static review must ensure no stringification hidden in diagnostic or comparison paths.

controls.name: find_recursion_and_long_hole_scans_share_terminal_budgets
controls.purpose: Distinguish find hole callbacks from sparse-skipping methods and prove unwind.
setup: Use bounded sources for recursive length getters, length valueOf, indexed getters, and predicates recursively calling the same method. Include a callback infinite loop and a huge all-hole receiver with a false-returning callback incrementing a retained counter.
Wrap each public invocation in try/catch/finally with prior=7 and separate caught/finalized markers; create a simple success guard first.
controls.action: Run one fresh entry per case later under an external process timeout/address-space cap; do not retry a terminated entry.
assertions: All infinite/recursive cases terminate with ResourceLimit, not native stack overflow, timeout or a successful missing result; no counter reset/refund occurs at callback boundaries.

Huge-hole traversal invokes the predicate at least once and then exhausts shared budget. Unlike every/some, a predicate that immediately throws on the first hole MUST throw its author marker, not be treated as unreachable.
Prior effects persist, uncatchable resource bypasses author catch/finally, and calls/stack_units/eval_depth/json_depth/frame/join guards restore their entry values.

controls.name: find_repeated_direct_calls_share_heap_and_work
controls.purpose: Catch accidental per-method resets and callback-frame retention.
setup: Prepare a one-element ordinary receiver and a simple native or user predicate; allocate all setup before measured entry. Invoke the same direct method repeatedly under one small shared allowance, at most 64 iterations.
Run user and native callback variants separately because normal activation costs legitimately differ.
controls.action: Repeatedly call array_method without execute between calls; inspect retained counters/guards after each completed or failed call.
assertions: Work decreases and cumulative charged heap increases monotonically until ResourceLimit. No refund or implicit new-entry budget is introduced.
Only completed author callback effects persist. Temporary machine frames do not remain live after return, although legitimate retained environments and cumulative accounting may grow.
Ignored thisArg/extra argument contents are not recursively inspected by the find arm; public argument expressions still evaluate before entry.

controls.name: find_property_lookup_work_tracks_retained_tree_shape
controls.purpose: Verify short-index lookups account for growing search trees, separately from long mapped names.
setup: Build valid ordinary objects with the same length and relevant short index but property-map sizes such as 1, 32 and 512; all setup precedes measured direct reduce_get entry. Include an absent-index control and a present descriptor control.

Prepare arrays with a small cached dense region and increasing valid hole-set sizes; keep compared index/shape roles explicit. A hole may require a later prototype edge, so do not equate it to a present own descriptor.
controls.action: Measure and then preflight just below the first charged read allowance on fresh equivalent runtimes; exercise through one first-match find-family call as a separate integration control.
assertions: Lookup work allowance grows with relevant retained tree size even though the query remains "0"; no traversal over all stored keys or extra heap-sized key copy is introduced.
A quota refusal happens before the indexed getter, callback or mapped lookup it is meant to protect. Earlier completed length/getter effects remain as required.
The mapped long-name comparison remains charged independently: a small property map does not justify a constant allowance for a long environment binding name.
Keep all old profile observations visible because stronger accounting can change resource boundaries; this is not authorization to narrow admission or raise limits.

reviewed: Descending getter/callback mutation and length shrink visit original captured range in reverse order.
Returned value is the pre-callback Get result even after replacement/deletion or callback argument rebinding.
Primitive receiver gets one shared wrapper; explicit wrappers keep original identity and UTF-16 string units are preserved.
Huge first visit clamps Infinity to 2^53-1 and uses 2^53-2 for the descending first index.
Dynamic Function mapped-arguments case is independently sloppy; descending method visits argument 1 then matches argument 0.

Counter checks cannot prove allocator-level containment; static charge placement remains necessary. Test budgets are to be measured on the final implementation rather than invented from successful candidate outcomes.

record.kind: Independent bounded static review of initial Array find-family core
scope: Four intrinsic registrations and early native dispatch
Shared reduce_property H1/H2 lookup precharges and retained Get/call/cleanup paths
record.overall: No concrete semantic, panic, invariant or resource-containment defect found in the reviewed changed core and selected retained call paths. This is static review, not candidate execution evidence or full conformance/security assessment.
semantics: The four distinct registered native identities use existing intrinsic_function with arity 1, the method name, ordinary Function prototype, nonenumerable writable configurable method properties and existing nonconstructable-native handling. Saved aliases dispatch by private identity even after public replacement or deletion.

array_method keeps ToObject and supported-host admission before length Get/conversion, then validates the callback even at length zero. Callback and thisArg come from the already evaluated argument values, so a length getter cannot replace them by rebinding author variables.

The new separate arm has no HasProperty call: each original-range index performs reduce_get, including holes and getterless accessors. Getter reads use the original receiver; inherited properties and mutations are observed live.

length is a u64 clamped ToLength. offset iterates 0..length; the descending subtraction is only reached while offset<length. It cannot underflow on an empty input or exceed the helper range. Index-to-f64 conversions are exact through 2^53-2.

Get returns an owned Value before callback allocation and invocation. The saved value remains distinct from the cloned callback argument, so replacement/deletion/arguments rebinding cannot change the selected value, while mutations of a shared object remain visible.

Callback arguments are exactly value, numeric index and original object. thisArg is forwarded unchanged to the shared call machinery; strict, sloppy, arrow and bound callee rules remain owned by that machinery.

Truthiness uses Value::truthy without author hooks or stringification. A true result returns the retained value or numeric index immediately, so later getters/prototype edges are not reached. Exhausted traversal returns Undefined or -1.

The find arm does not write length/indices, construct a result array, consult species/iterator protocols or materialize a list of indices. Extra arguments are ignored after normal caller-side evaluation.
resource_review: Each index has a visit tick, 17-work/64-byte checked decimal key construction, one bounded property walk, and a charged three-Value argument buffer. The fixed-size arithmetic 32+3*size_of::<Value>() cannot approach usize overflow on supported targets. try_reserve_exact(3) precedes extend; failure propagates without discarding earlier getter effects.

No storage or loop precharge derives from logical length. Huge first matches and first throws can complete with one visit; unsuccessful ranges consume the shared work/heap budget per visit. The receiver/callback/value/thisArg are owned Values, with Rc-backed strings/native identities, not deep clones of arbitrary contents.

lookup_work computes zero for empty tables and otherwise uses saturating short-key chunk cost times 4*(1+floor(log2(entries))). The values search, two parameter_map searches and possible array-hole search are prepaid before those reads. This is a conservative accounting model, not a claim of instruction-exact Rust B-tree costs.

Actual mapped binding-name UTF-8 length and environment search depth are charged before own_property snapshots the alias value. The metadata is borrowed; no long-name String allocation is introduced. H1 is addressed in this path.

Native/JSON/Math property-object lookup is prepaid up to three times to cover initial resolution, own_property and absent-property prototype resolution. Per-edge 128-byte scratch remains charged before possible boxed-string single-unit allocation. H2 is addressed in the reviewed walker.

Quotas and MAX_DEPTH/MAX_CALLS/MAX_STACK_UNITS are unchanged. No new budget reset/refund exists. Table work is computed without iterating keys; no receiver/prototype/callback borrow survives into author code.

Runtime::call and machine::drive restore entry call/stack/depth/frame state when a callback returns or errors. The new arm uses those existing checked paths and propagates resource/unsupported errors; it does not introduce a catch or cleanup callback.
host_boundaries: Direct unsupported Window/Document/DOM/CSSOM-style receivers are rejected before length access. Symbol sidecars do not satisfy property_object and cannot silently widen admission.

Ordinary objects with host prototypes remain admissible while required own properties suffice. A reached host edge is explicitly unsupported, and a successful match prevents later host or cyclic edges from being visited.

Valid-arena cyclic prototypes remain bounded by the walker depth and shared quotas. As before, a chain whose final null would require a further iteration at the exact MAX_DEPTH boundary may conservatively hit the depth limit; no expanded chain-conformance claim is made.
regression_attention: The stronger walker accounting applies to existing array methods and reductions. Older observations must remain visible; a changed resource boundary is not grounds for filtering tests or raising quotas.

The planned F01 allocation control must measure a Get-only indexed prefix, unlike previous Has+Get controls. All-hole find loops must invoke predicates; the every/some unreachable-callback sparse control cannot be copied unchanged.

Pending private checks should exercise exact allocation refusal after getter effects, long-name refusal before alias reads, growing retained search-tree sizes, sparse huge first matches, native callback receivers and shared terminal unwinding.
limits: No candidate binary or private tests were executed in this review.
No Proxy, typed/resizable array, BigInt, broad host integrity or full Array conformance claim.
Array @@unscopables population/with-environment behavior remains outside this four-method algorithm slice; this review does not claim that broader adjunct is implemented.
Initialization and retained unrelated helper allocations were not exhaustively audited. Valid internally constructed arena IDs are assumed.

record.kind: Independent bounded static final delta and private-test review for Array find family
record.delta_result: Only cfg(test) find_tests module registration; all other previously reviewed files match their original full-byte hashes.
record.test_count_note: 13 test groups includes one unchanged-fixture replay group covering 504 strict/sloppy modes; the other 12 target private semantics and resource invariants.
review_observations: first_get_prefix measures the actual length plus indexed Get path without HasProperty. The allocation-refusal test uses equivalent fresh runtimes, length one for both directions, and places exhaustion one byte inside the three-value buffer preflight. It asserts the getter already ran, the callback did not, and the earlier touched property remains. Hole and getterless-accessor controls reach that same callback preflight.

Huge first-match tests save full ToLength through 2^53-1, Infinity and 1e100, and calculate the correct first descending index. Equal allocation comparisons keep object shape fixed, then separately check a logical u32::MAX sparse Array without materializing indices or dense storage.

Index-key tests isolate 17-work and 64-byte boundaries and refusal for out-of-range u64 before changing budgets. Mapped-argument tests use a real sloppy retained environment, verify the live alias differs from the stored descriptor, preserve the mapping name pointer, and refuse below measured work before 128-byte snapshot charging.

Values/parameter-map/hole-tree size probes vary actual retained search structures. Present and absent branches retain separate assertions; only the present-key getter is reachable, and the no-callback assertion is not used as evidence for a nonexistent getter on an absent key.

The host tests establish symbol sidecars yet still require unsupported direct host receivers; ordinary own-hit early matches avoid a later host edge, while continued traversal reaches it. Cyclic prototype tests use valid arena IDs. Depth 96 versus 97 tests place the actual getter at that depth and verify original receiver plus getter/callback nonexecution after the limit.

Boxed-string controls include lone surrogate code units and test the conservative per-edge allocation preflight without mutating wrapper properties. Retained-value tests verify a shared long UTF-16 string pointer survives callback mutation of both the receiver and arguments; poison coercion/then hooks remain uncalled.

Final repeated-direct-call controls retrieve the actual installed Boolean from each fresh realm rather than fabricate a Native with an incorrect receiver identity. Both native and author branches measure actual allocation and then require exactly three completed calls before the fourth resource stop. Lookup occurs before the measured invocation and does not reset quotas inside the repeated loop.

Recursion through length, numeric conversion, indexed getter and predicate shares terminal resource behavior, with prior effects retained and catch/finally skipped. The all-hole huge scan actually invokes callbacks; a first-hole author throw remains an ordinary catchable identity control.
Cleanup assertions cover calls, weighted stack, expression/JSON depth, machine frames and active join stack. These are static setup observations, not independent execution results.

first_candidate_evidence.note: Comparison is retained evidence produced by root, not a new reviewer engine run. Initial failed candidate is not overwritten.

diff_review.result: Only actual-digit formatter accounting/loop and corresponding private test expectations changed. H1/H2 lookups, all quotas, method algorithms and JavaScript fixtures remain unchanged.

semantic_and_accounting_checks: Safe-integer range refusal remains first, before digit computation or either budget change. checked_ilog10 on u64 performs no allocation or author callback, gives None for zero and exact integer powers-of-ten boundaries; adding one yields 1..16 for the admitted range.

work(1 + count) and charge(64) precede stack-buffer initialization, digit writes, and JsString construction. Work refusal cannot perform a heap charge. Heap refusal retains the existing monotonic cumulative charge and does not construct the output string.

start = 16 - count cannot underflow. The reverse iterator visits exactly count initialized suffix cells, and each integer remainder/division writes one ASCII UTF-16 digit. Zero visits one cell and yields 0; maximum safe integer visits sixteen. No truncation, leading zeros or floating log rounding are introduced.

The fixed array and returned shared string retain their existing maximum storage and 64-byte precharge. Sixteen-digit indices retain 17 work units; shorter indices pay one fixed entry plus each actual formatted digit. This is the existing abstract work model, not instruction-exact billing of the integer log intrinsic or stack initialization.

No author-visible property operation was reordered, and no budget reset/refund, length cap, feature gate or outcome filter was added. Loop work still grows per visit, with a minimum two-unit formatting charge plus callers own visit/lookup/callback charges.

Shared production callers include generic Array methods and result-property construction, Array.lastIndexOf, reduce/reduceRight, and json_text Array string conversion. The latter is array-to-string conversion, not a separate JSON replacer-list optimization.
private_test_review: Expected work is derived from independently specified decimal text length + 1, rather than repeating the implementation log expression.

Literal cases cover 0, 9, 10, 99, 100, 4294967294, 999999999999999, 1000000000000000, 9007199254740990 and 9007199254740991. Each checks one-unit-short work refusal with unchanged allocated count, exact-work success with zero work left and exact 64-byte heap consumption, plus one-byte-short heap refusal.

9007199254740992 and u64::MAX are rejected before work/heap changes. The older reduce zero-key refusal now has one available step, correctly testing the new two-step minimum; its long-key 17-step control remains intact.
The original fixed-17 controls and initial lost-pass observations are preserved in the first-candidate source archive and earlier immutable reviews; changed resource expectations are explicit.
regression_attention: Root must rerun both unchanged lost modes and all shared-caller profiles/local/private controls using the corrected binary.
Keep every old case and control fingerprint and retain any resource transitions. No claim that restored outcomes have been independently executed in this review.
Date preparation remains frozen and has not been executed.
record.conclusion: No concrete defect found in the reviewed correction. Preflight ordering, finite scratch storage, decimal semantics and retained lookup accounting are sound under the existing model.

execution_attribution.reviewer_activity: Static source/test/evidence inspection and SHA-256/byte-diff verification only.

record.kind: Independent bounded static review of guarded find-family preflights
semantic_review: Every new source first checks method type, a successful true predicate with the correct value/index result, a false predicate with the proper absent result, and exactly two calls. These operations precede the individual semantic setup and its negative assertion.

Good and deliberate-bad variants share identical setup. Final asserted expected values are observably different in each of the 16 groups for all four methods: no bad expectation aliases a correct Undefined/-1/index/value/trace.

Direction and inherited-hole traces include all three visits, preserving Undefined holes. Saved-result pairs distinguish the original object token from its replacement; index variants distinguish 0 from 1.

Boolean short-circuit uses a truthy object with poisoned coercion and a later getter that must remain unread. Captured length/live mutation deletes a future value, changes a later endpoint and appends outside the original range without visiting appended elements.

Length-getter and numeric-conversion trace precedes invalid callback validation even when converted length is zero. Nullish receiver cases check actual TypeError and no callback after the successful guard.

Strict callback controls preserve exact object/Undefined/primitive thisArg. Dynamic Function callbacks are independently sloppy in either caller mode and exercise primitive boxing plus default Window this.

Callback/getter abrupt tests require the exact thrown object and correct earlier visit trace. A swallowed/missing invocation fails the positive pair; a wrong thrown class cannot simply replace the requested identity.
Live-getter mutation and generic-string traces have correct reversed expectations; string callback receives the wrapper. No-species verifies constructor getter remains uncalled.

Property metadata uses unchanged propertyHelper with restore:true, verifies method/name/length flags, absent own prototype and TypeError on construction. The final arity mismatch is deliberately wrong.

gate_review.expected_failure_requires: failed status plus diagnostic Test262Error, as in existing harness policy
gate_review.overall: all(item.verified) includes every positive and bad pair plus core controls
gate_review.qualification: An individual bad variant can fail at its availability guard with Test262Error on an old engine and therefore appear verified; this does not validate that semantic bad assertion. Its corresponding positive also fails, so the complete gate remains false. Preserve raw failures and do not report those individual negative results as implementation success.

record.bounds: Finite fixed 288-source control inventory; callbacks visit tiny bounded receivers. Existing fresh-process deadline/output limits and shared Runtime limits apply only when owner executes. No adapter was run for this static review.
record.limits: No full tool/security review, candidate execution, tests, builds, source rewrites or admission changes. This report binds the draft and runner snapshots above; later changes require attribution.
